templates.title: WhatsApp Message Templates
templates.description: Create and manage WhatsApp Business message templates. Templates must be approved by Meta before use. Use templates to send messages outside the 24-hour messaging window
templates.createFirst: Create your first template to get started
templates.connectRequiredDescription: Connect a WhatsApp Business account before creating or syncing message templates.

alerts.deleteConfirmation: Are you sure you want to delete template {name}? This action cannot be undone.
alerts.createSuccess: Template created and sent to Meta for review.
alerts.savedTemplates: Showing saved templates. Meta refresh is temporarily unavailable; approval status may have changed.
alerts.refreshUnavailable: Meta cannot refresh templates right now. Please try again later.
alerts.refreshCooldown: Meta is limiting refreshes. Try again after {time}.
alerts.deleteIdNotFound: Cannot delete: template ID not found
alerts.switchToCurrentWabaSuccess: Submitted {name} to the current WhatsApp Business Account.
alerts.switchToCurrentWabaFailed: Failed to switch this template to the current WABA

flowHealth.screenMissing: The "{button}" button opens screen {screen}, but Flow "{flow}" no longer has it. Customers can't open it.
flowHealth.notPublished: Flow "{flow}" isn't published. Customers can't open the "{button}" button.
flowHealth.deprecated: Flow "{flow}" is retired. Customers can't open the "{button}" button.
flowHealth.blocked: Meta blocked Flow "{flow}". Customers can't open the "{button}" button.
flowHealth.missing: The Flow for the "{button}" button wasn't found in this WABA. Customers can't open it.

form.replyButtonHint: Tapping sends the button text as a reply in this chat.
form.urlButtonHint: Tapping opens this website. It does not send a chat reply.
form.update: Update template components. Changes require Meta approval.
form.create: Create a new WhatsApp message template. It will be submitted for Meta review.
form.name: Template Name
form.nameValidation: Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only. Cannot be changed after creation.

categoryHints.UTILITY: Updates about an order or account the customer already has.

form.headerFormattingWarning: Headers can't be formatted: WhatsApp already shows them in bold. Remove * _ ~ ` or Meta may reject the template.
form.bodyValidation: Use '{{1}}', '{{2}}', etc. for variables. Max 1024 characters.
form.layoutHint: A WhatsApp marketing template has one shape. A carousel is not a button: it replaces the message header, footer, and buttons.
form.layoutStandardDescription: One bubble. Add a header, footer, and buttons if you need them.
form.layoutStandardIncludes: Optional header, footer, and message buttons
form.layoutCarouselDescription: A body plus a row of product cards. Each card has its own image or video and buttons.
form.layoutCarouselIncludes: Body plus 2–10 media cards with card buttons
form.layoutCarouselExcludes: Cannot include a message header, footer, or buttons
form.layoutHiddenStandard: Header, footer, and message buttons are hidden for this shape but stay saved. Switch to Standard message to edit them.
form.layoutHiddenCarousel: Carousel cards are hidden for this shape but stay saved. Switch to Media carousel to edit them.
form.carouselHint: Every card uses the same media type and the same buttons in the same order. Card buttons can mix Quick reply, URL, and Phone. Flow buttons are not available.
form.carouselButtonsHint: Every card shows these buttons in this order ({count} of {max}), with at most one phone button. Labels, links, and phone numbers can differ per card.
form.authPresetHint: Meta generates the fixed message and copy-code button in the selected language. The preview is illustrative. Your verification service must generate and validate the code.
form.authSecurityRecommendation: Include a warning not to share the code
form.authExpiryHint: Choose 1–90 minutes to display an expiry warning. This does not set the code's actual lifetime; match your verification service.
form.inlineAuthenticationUnsupported: Authentication templates use Meta's verification-code preset. Create one in WhatsApp Manager; custom message text cannot be submitted from this editor.
form.requestContactInfoHelp: Meta fixes this button label. It asks a BSUID contact to share their phone number.
form.flowNavigateScreenHelp: Use a screen id from the selected Flow JSON.
form.previewHint: Based on your current inputs. Variables can be renamed and previewed with custom values.
form.previewEmpty: Start typing to see a preview.
form.selectTemplateHint: Select a template card to start editing, or create a new one.
form.variableNameError: Variable name must use only lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores.
form.editDisabledMissingMetaId: Cannot edit WhatsApp content: Meta template ID is missing.
form.editDisabledMissingDbId: Cannot edit Telegram/unified content: database template ID is missing.
form.editDisabledStatus: Meta only allows editing WhatsApp templates after they are Approved, Rejected, or Paused. Delete or duplicate this template instead.
form.checklistVariables: Variables are consecutive and placed correctly
form.staleVersion: The app was updated while this editor was open, so the template wasn't sent. Your draft is saved: reload and send it again.
form.mediaExamplePlaceholder: Public media URL or Meta header handle
form.mediaRequirement: Provide a sample media URL or existing Meta header handle so Meta can review this media header.
form.mediaDropzoneDescription: Drag and drop a file here, or attach from device.
form.templateVideoRequirement: Template videos must be MP4 or 3GP and 16MB or smaller.
form.templateVideoTooLarge: Template videos must be 16MB or smaller.
form.templateVideoUnsupported: Template videos must be MP4 or 3GP. MOV is not supported for WhatsApp templates.
form.variablePlacementError: Text cannot start or end with a variable (e.g., '{{1}}'). Add some text before/after the variable.
form.variableNumberingError: Variables must be numbered consecutively starting from '{{1}}'.

errors.authExpiryRange: Choose a whole number from 1 to 90 minutes, or leave it empty.
errors.marketingMaxPriceCategory: Max price is only supported for marketing templates
errors.marketingMaxPriceBidAmount: Bid amount must be a positive whole number
errors.headerMax: Header must be 60 characters or less
errors.headerOneVariable: The header can have only one variable.
errors.headerMediaExampleRequired: Media headers require a sample media URL or Meta header handle
errors.carouselMarketingOnly: Carousels are only available for marketing templates
errors.carouselCardMediaRequired: Each carousel card needs a sample image or video
errors.carouselCardBodyRequired: Each carousel card needs body text
errors.carouselCardButtonRequired: Each carousel card needs at least one button
errors.authBodyVariableRequired: Authentication templates must include a variable for the OTP code, for example '{{1}}'.
errors.bodyMax: Body must be 1024 characters or less
errors.footerMax: Footer must be 60 characters or less
errors.urlRequired: URL is required for URL buttons
errors.urlVariablePlacement: A link can have one variable, only at its very end, like 'https://shop.com/{{1}}'.
errors.variablesMixed: Use named variables like '{{first_name}}' or numbered ones like '{{1}}' in the header, body, and cards, not both.
errors.variableNameInvalid: Variable names can use only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores, like '{{first_name}}'.
errors.phoneRequired: Phone number is required for phone buttons
errors.flowRequired: Flow buttons need exactly one of flow_id, flow_name, or flow_json
errors.flowNavigateScreenRequired: Navigate screen is required when Flow action is Navigate
errors.maxOneFlowButton: Only one flow button is allowed per template
errors.maxOnePhoneButton: Only one phone button is allowed per template
errors.maxTwoUrlButtons: Only two URL buttons are allowed per template
errors.flowNameMax: Flow name must be 256 characters or less
errors.telegramMax: Message must be 4096 characters or less
errors.nameMax: Name must be less than 512 characters
errors.nameAlphanumeric: Name must be lowercase alphanumeric with underscores only
